40022059.author: पदार्थः
40022059.content: तयोः of those two, संवदतोः while conversing, एवम् thus, रामलक्ष्मणयोः of Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, तदा then, वासन्तिकी of spring, निशा night, प्राप्ता arrived, न शीता not cold, न च nor, घर्मदा hot.

40022059.author: Translation
40022059.content: As Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa thus conversed, the spring night arrived, which was neither cold nor hot.

40022060.author: पदार्थः
40022060.content: ततः then, प्रभाते in the morning, विमले clear, कृतपौर्वाह्णिकक्रियः having performed the morning rituals, अभिचक्राम approached, काकुत्स्थो Kakutstha (Rama), दर्शनं the audience hall, पौरकार्यवित् knowing the affairs of the citizens.

40022060.author: Translation
40022060.content: Then, in the clear morning, Rama, having completed his morning rituals and being knowledgeable about the citizens' affairs, proceeded to the audience hall.

40022061.author: पदार्थः
40022061.content: ततः then, सुमन्त्रस्त्वागम्य Sumantra having come, राघवं to Rama, वाक्यमब्रवीत् spoke words, एते these, प्रतिहता stopped, राजन् O King, द्वारि at the door, तिष्ठन्ति are standing, तापसाः ascetics.

40022061.author: Translation
40022061.content: Then Sumantra approached Rama and informed him, "O King, these ascetics are standing at the door, having been stopped."

40022062.author: पदार्थः
40022062.content: भार्गवच्यवनं Bhrigu's son Chyavana, चैव and indeed, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, महर्षयः great sages, दर्शनं audience, ते your, महाराज्ञश्चोदयन्ति are urging (of the great king), कृतत्वराः eagerly, प्रीयमाणा pleased, नरव्याघ्र O tiger among men, यमुनातीरवासिनः residents of the Yamuna bank.

40022062.author: Translation
40022062.content: These great sages, residents of the Yamuna bank and pleased to see you, O tiger among men, are eagerly requesting an audience with you, led by Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu.

40022063.author: पदार्थः
40022063.content: तस्य his, तद्वचनं those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, प्रोवाच said, धर्मवित् knower of dharma, प्रवेश्यन्तां let them be admitted, महाभागा highly fortunate ones, भार्गवप्रमुखा led by Bhrigu's son, द्विजाः Brahmins.

40022063.author: Translation
40022063.content: Hearing those words, Rama, the knower of dharma, commanded that the revered Brahmins, led by Chyavana, be admitted.

40022064.author: पदार्थः
40022064.content: राज्ञस्त्वाज्ञां the king's command, पुरस्कृत्य honoring, द्वाःस्थो the doorkeeper, मूर्ध्नि on his head, कृताञ्जलिः having folded hands, प्रवेशयामास caused to enter, तदा then, तापसान्सुदुरासदान् the ascetics who were very difficult to approach.

40022064.author: Translation
40022064.content: Then, the doorkeeper, honoring the king's command by placing it on his head and with folded hands, admitted those ascetics who were otherwise very difficult to approach.

40022065.author: पदार्थः
40022065.content: शतं a hundred, समधिकं more than, तत्र there, दीप्यमानं shining, स्वतेजसा with their own splendor, प्रविष्टं entered, राजभवनं the royal palace, तापसानां of ascetics, महात्मनाम् of great souls.

40022065.author: Translation
40022065.content: More than a hundred great-souled ascetics, shining with their own spiritual radiance, entered the royal palace.

40022066.author: पदार्थः
40022066.content: ते those, द्विजाः Brahmins, पूर्णकलशैः with full pitchers, सर्वतीर्थाम्बुसत्कृतैः honored with waters from all sacred fords, गृहीत्वा having taken, फलमूलं fruits and roots, च and, रामस्य for Rama, अभ्याहरन् brought, बहु much.

40022066.author: Translation
40022066.content: Those Brahmins brought many offerings for Rama, including full pitchers honored with waters from all sacred pilgrimage sites, and various fruits and roots.

40022067.author: पदार्थः
40022067.content: प्रतिगृह्य having received, तु indeed, तत्सर्वं all that, रामः Rama, प्रीतिपुरस्कृतः honored with affection, तीर्थोदकानि sacred waters, सर्वाणि all, फलानि fruits, विविधानि various, च and.

40022067.author: Translation
40022067.content: Rama, showing great affection, received all those offerings, including all the sacred waters and various fruits.

40022068.author: पदार्थः
40022068.content: उवाच said, च and, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed (Rama), सर्वानेव all indeed, महामुनीन् to the great sages, इमानि these, आसनमुख्यानि excellent seats, यथार्हं as appropriate, उपविश्यताम् may be sat upon.

40022068.author: Translation
40022068.content: The mighty-armed Rama then addressed all the great sages, inviting them to take these excellent seats as was appropriate for their stature.

40022069.author: पदार्थः
40022069.content: रामस्य Rama's, भाषितं words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सर्व all, एव indeed, महर्षयः great sages, बृसीषु on the seats, रुचिराख्यासु beautiful, निषेदुः sat down, काञ्चनीषु golden, ते they.

40022069.author: Translation
40022069.content: Having heard Rama's words, all the great sages sat down on the beautiful, well-known golden seats.

40022070.author: पदार्थः
40022070.content: उपविष्टान् seated, ऋषीन् sages, तत्र there, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परपुरञ्जयः the conqueror of enemy cities, प्रयतः reverent, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, राघवः Rama, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40022070.author: Translation
40022070.content: Having seen the sages seated there, Rama, the conqueror of enemy cities, reverently and with folded hands, spoke these words.

40022071.author: पदार्थः
40022071.content: किम् what, आगमनकार्यम् purpose of coming, वः your, किम् what, करोमि shall I do, समाहितः attentively, आज्ञाप्यः to be commanded, अहम् I, महर्षीणाम् of the great sages, सर्वकामकरः one who fulfills all desires, सुखम् easily.

40022071.author: Translation
40022071.content: He asked what the purpose of their visit was and what he could do for them attentively, declaring himself to be at the command of the great sages, ready to fulfill all their desires easily.

40022072.author: पदार्थः
40022072.content: इदम् this, राज्यम् kingdom, च and, सकलम् entire, जीवितम् life, च and, हृदि in the heart, स्थितम् situated, सर्वम् all, एतत् this, द्विदार्थम् for the sake of the Brahmins, मे my, सत्यम् truth, एतत् this, ब्रवीमि I speak, वः to you.

40022072.author: Translation
40022072.content: Rama declared that his entire kingdom, his very life, and everything he possessed was for the sake of the Brahmins, and he spoke this truth to them.

40022073.author: पदार्थः
40022073.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, साधुकारः applause, महान् great, अभूत् occurred, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, उग्रतपसाम् of severe austerities, यमुनातीरवासिनाम् residing on the banks of Yamuna.

40022073.author: Translation
40022073.content: Having heard his words, a great applause arose from the sages of severe austerities who resided on the banks of the Yamuna.

40022074.author: पदार्थः
40022074.content: ऊचुः they said, च and, ते those, महात्मानः great souls, हर्षेण with joy, महता great, वृताः filled, उपपन्नम् fitting, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, तव your, एव only, भुवि on earth, न not, अन्यतः from anyone else.

40022074.author: Translation
40022074.content: And those great souls, filled with great joy, said, "O best among men, such a statement is fitting only for you on earth, and for no one else."

40022075.author: पदार्थः
40022075.content: बहवः many, पार्थिवाः kings, राजन् O King, अतिक्रान्ताः who came before, महाबलाः very powerful, कार्यस्य of the task, गौरवम् gravity, मत्वा having considered, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, न not, अभ्यरोचयन् undertook.

40022075.author: Translation
40022075.content: Many powerful kings who came before you, O King, considered the gravity of this task and did not undertake the vow.

40022076.author: पदार्थः
40022076.content: त्वया by you, पुनर् but, ब्राह्मणगौरवात् out of respect for Brahmins, इयम् this, कृता made, प्रतिज्ञा vow, हि indeed, अनवेक्ष्य without considering, कारणम् the reason, ततश्च therefore, कर्ता the doer, हि indeed, असि you are, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt, महाभयात् from great fear, त्रातुम् to protect, ऋषीन् the sages, त्वम् you, अर्हसि ought.

40022076.author: Translation
40022076.content: But you, out of respect for Brahmins, made this vow without considering the difficulty, and therefore you are indeed the one who will accomplish it, without a doubt, and you ought to protect the sages from great fear. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 60 ।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
